data.name: Server Structural FEA Engineer
locations: Santa Clara, California, United States of America
Republic of China - Remote TWN, Taiwan
data.jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm's Data Center team is developing high-performance, energy-efficient server solutions for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, and collaborative individuals to contribute to cutting-edge server technology development. 


Our Mission

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. By joining our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative solutions that advance performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm Snapdragon SoCs and delivering comprehensive hardware and software solutions, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and related enablement. 


Position Summary

We are seeking a Staff / Senior Staff Server Structural FEA Engineer with deep expertise in semiconductor package mechanics, structural reliability, and advanced finite element analysis. The role focuses on structural integrity and reliability of server SoCs, spanning die- and package-level behavior through interaction with the server platform. The scope includes both soldered and socketed SoC packages and their mechanical interaction with PCBs, sockets and retention systems, cooling solutions, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.


The ideal candidate is a recognized subject matter expert who can develop predictive methodologies, evaluate failure mechanisms, quantify design margins and uncertainty, and translate analysis into actionable package and platform design guidance. The engineer will assess structural behavior across package assembly, system integration, qualification, and operation, with emphasis on chip-package interaction (CPI), warpage, die and interconnect integrity, solder-joint reliability, and mechanically coupled thermal interface risks.


This senior individual contributor will work closely with package engineering, computational modeling, thermal, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, reliability, and system/platform engineering teams to align assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions, failure criteria, and correlation approaches. The engineer will develop independent analyses where needed and partner with system-level structural FEA engineers to connect SoC/package mechanical behavior to broader platform and lifecycle assessments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and apply advanced structural and thermo-mechanical FEA methodologies for server SoCs and advanced semiconductor packages, including CPI, package assembly, warpage, stress, deformation, and structural reliability.
  • Evaluate both soldered and socketed packages under package assembly, SMT, socket and retention loading, cooling-system loading, temperature cycling, qualification, and operating conditions.
  • Analyze package-to-platform mechanical interaction among the SoC package, PCB, socket or retention system, heatsink or cold plate, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.
  • Apply advanced FEA techniques including submodeling, contact analysis, material and geometric nonlinearity, viscoelasticity, creep, fatigue, fracture or damage mechanics, and coupled structural-thermal analysis as appropriate.
  • Develop physics-based reliability and life-prediction models for relevant failure mechanisms, including solder and bump fatigue, die and BEOL stress, substrate and interposer cracking, delamination, and creep. Perform BLR and solder-joint reliability analyses to quantify damage accumulation, design margins, and expected life.
  • Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and bounding analyses to identify dominant parameters, quantify structural risk, and guide package and platform architecture decisions before hardware is available.
  • Define model-validation and correlation strategies using material characterization, package/board measurements, reliability and qualification testing, manufacturing data, and system-level test results, including development of test vehicles and methods where needed.
  • Partner with package engineering and computational modeling teams to align modeling assumptions, material properties, process inputs, boundary conditions, revision control, correlation methodologies, and failure criteria.
  • Develop independent analyses, sensitivity studies, or targeted model cross-checks as needed to reconcile differing predictions, quantify uncertainty, and evaluate server-specific package-to-platform boundary conditions.
  • Work closely with system/platform structural-analysis engineers to provide package mechanical properties, load limits, deformation behavior, and failure criteria supporting broader platform, system, and rack-level lifecycle analyses.
  • Apply expertise in package architectures and substrate technologies, including FCBGA, FCLGA/HFCBGA, chiplet-based designs, HBM integration, 2.5D interposers or bridges, and 3D packaging technologies.
  • Develop scalable workflows, automation, modeling standards, best-known methods (BKMs), and validation frameworks. Experience with ANSYS APDL-based workflow development is strongly preferred. 
  • Translate complex simulation results into clear design requirements and recommendations for cross-functional engineering teams, leadership, customers, and suppliers.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of advanced FEA experience in semiconductor packaging, microelectronics assembly, CPI, structural reliability, and interconnect technologies.
  • Strong foundation in structural and failure mechanics, materials science, thermo-mechanical behavior, fatigue and creep, with experience applying nonlinear FEA techniques including contact, submodeling, thermal cycling, and interconnect reliability analysis. 
  • Demonstrated experience modeling semiconductor-package failure mechanisms and correlating simulations with experimental, manufacturing, or qualification data.
  • Proficiency in ANSYS Workbench, ANSYS APDL, ABAQUS, or equivalent nonlinear FEA tools.
  • Proven ability to operate independently and lead in cross-functional environments, with strong technical documentation, communication, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field.
  • Deep expertise in package mechanics, CPI, package assembly simulation, warpage prediction, die and BEOL reliability, and solder or interconnect reliability.
  • Demonstrated experience with both soldered and socketed high-pin-count server packages and package interaction with PCBs, sockets, retention hardware, heatsinks or cold plates, and TIM materials. 
  • Proven experience developing physics-based reliability models and life predictions for solder joints, bumps, die/package structures, substrates, interposers, underfill, adhesives, or related failure mechanisms.
  • Proven simulation-to-test correlation using warpage measurements, strain or displacement measurements, material characterization, thermal-cycling data, mechanical loading tests, or qualification results.
  • Experience developing APDL automation, reusable workflows, modeling standards, and BKMs.
  • Experience with coupled structural-thermal analysis and mechanical/thermal co-optimization.
  • Understanding of server and OCP platform designs and associated assembly, handling, transportation, qualification, and operating environments.

Minimum Qualifications:

•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

Pay range and Other Compensation & Benefits:

The above pay scale reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay scale for this job code for the location for which it has been posted. Even more importantly, please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Qualcomm.  We also offer a competitive annual discretionary bonus program and opportunity for annual RSU grants (employees on sales-incentive plans are not eligible for our annual bonus).  In addition, our highly competitive benefits package is designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play. data.name: Hardware Security Architect – Staff
data.jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

In this position you will join the team responsible for the security architecture of Qualcomm Snapdragon processors. The team works at a system level spanning across hardware, software and infrastructure while striving for industry-leading solutions. This team interacts with product management, customers (e.g., OEMs), partners, HW/SW engineering, and Services engineering teams to find the optimal Security solution. Snapdragon processors are utilized in a variety of devices, including mobile phones, laptops, automotive systems, and data centers, each with distinct security needs. These processors are engineered to address most of these requirements, encompassing a wide range of security technologies found in consumer electronics, such as Root of Trust, Integrated Secure Element, Virtualization, and Confidential Compute.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years industry experience in SoC Security encompassing both architecture and design
  • 5+ years industry experience in Compute and/or Data Centre SoC Architecture
  • Demonstrated expertise in Security Technologies (Root of Trust, TEE, Access Control, I/O Security)
  • Proficient in Confidential Compute Architecture (RME, TDX, SEV-SNP, TDISP)
  • Strong understanding of Security Software Architecture for Compute and Data Centers, with a focus on Secure Boot.
  • Skilled in HW/SW threat analysis
  • Strong capabilities in creating and presenting architecture-level documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficient in isolation-related extensions, including TrustZone, Virtualization, and RME.
  • Extensive knowledge of Server Platform security architecture covering lifecycle/debug management, provisioning, attestation/measurement.
  • Expertise in Applied Cryptography and Protocols.
  • Knowledgeable about Security Certification Processes and Requirements (such as OCP)
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Leadership and management experience at the project level

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish system security requirements (both hardware and software) for Server SoC focusing on functionality, performance, and security levels.
  • Specify and review the architecture and implementation of System/SoC level security mechanisms.
  • Conduct platform security threat analysis.
  • Perform competitive analysis of security systems and features
  • Explore future and roadmap server security-related technologies.
  • Serve as the technical interface to product management and standards teams.

Minimum Qualifications:

•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

data.name: SoC Physical Design Engineer (Senior to Principal)
locations: Ho Chi Minh, Hồ Chí Minh, Vietnam
standardizedLocations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, VN
data.jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm Vietnam Company Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives communication and data processing transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all.   

As a Qualcomm HW SoC Engineer, you will define, model, design (digital and/or analog), optimize, verify, validate, implement, and document IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power world class products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path. 

We are seeking a seasoned Staff / Sr Staff Physical Design Engineer to provide technical leadership across block-level, die-level and chip-level physical implementation on advanced FinFET nodes. You will define and own the backend design methodology, champion Agentic AI integration into the PD flow, and mentor engineers across the team while interfacing directly with foundry, EDA vendors, and executive stakeholders. 

 

Minimum Qualifications: 

Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC physical design, ECO, STA, physical verification, power analysis or related work experience. 
OR 
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of ASIC physical design, ECO, STA, physical verification, power analysis or related work experience. 
OR 
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of ASIC physical design, ECO, STA, physical verification, power analysis or related work experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master's degree in VLSI, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Physic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science with 3+ years of experience. 

  • Deep expertise in full chip and block level floor-planning, design implementation through place and route, ECO, STA, LEC / Timing / Power closure, and Physical Verification; 

  • Experience with power optimization (DVFS, multi-Vt, power domains, UPF/CPF) 

  • Advanced Shell, Python and Tcl scripting: ability to architect large-scale SOC back-end automation frameworks and flow infrastructure 

  • Demonstrated experience or vision for applying Agentic AI methodologies to EDA challenges: autonomous agents, AI-driven optimization, LLM-assisted debugging 

  • Strong communication skills: ability to present methodology decisions, risk assessments, and tape out readiness to senior management 

 

Principal Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Leverages advanced ASIC knowledge and experience to define, model, design (digital, analog and/or mix signal), optimize, verify, validate and implement IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power products. 

  • Participates in or leads the design implementation of advanced design rules and processes for electronic hardware, equipment, and/or integrated circuitry. 

  • Conducts highly complex simulations and analyses of designs as well as implements designs with the best power, performance, and area. 

  • Evaluates all aspects of complex process flow from high-level design to synthesis, place and route, timing and power use, and verification or similarly for custom circuit design/layout flow. 

  • Utilizes tools/applications (e.g., RTL to GDS Flow) to execute and enable advanced architecture and design of multiple complex blocks/SoC or IC Packages. 

  • Writes and reviews detailed technical documentation for complex EDA/IP/ASIC projects. 

 

Level of Responsibility: 

  • Works independently with minimal supervision. 

  • Provides supervision/guidance to other team members. 

  • Decision-making is significant in nature and affects work beyond immediate work group. 

  • Requires verbal and written communication skills to convey complex information. May require negotiation, influence, tact, etc.  

  • Has a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to make key decisions). 

  • Tasks do not have defined steps; planning, problem-solving, and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively. 

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
